settings.hero_desc: A precise scale replica of your industrial product - here a water-cooled chiller unit with pumps and pipework - reproduced in detail and presented under a clear case with a branded plaque. A professional showcase and gift for equipment and engineering firms. Send a commission inquiry to convert your products into a scaled model.
settings.perso_placeholder: Your equipment, colours, branding and display case
settings.s1_body: Hard to bring a chiller, pump skid or control unit into a meeting? We build it in miniature. This scale model reproduces your equipment down to the pumps, panels and pipework, finished in your branding and presented under a clear case with a plaque. A memorable showcase piece and gift for equipment manufacturers and their clients.
settings.case_body: Commissioned by Byrne Equipment, these cased models let the team showcase their units at exhibitions and in the sales office - a tangible reminder that clients loved seeing on the table.
settings.case_quote: Clients loved seeing a miniature of the exact unit we make. We have 20 products so it's easier to showcase everything in one go.
settings.prov_p: A scale model brings equipment that's too big for the boardroom right onto the table - cased, branded and built to last. It's a sales aid and a showpiece in one.
